questions.text: What kind of home do you live in?
questions.say: Good evening. My name is Alice, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about your home. What kind of home do you live in?

questions.text: Which room do you spend the most time in? Why?
questions.say: Which room do you spend the most time in? Why?

questions.text: Do you have a view from your window?
questions.say: Do you have a view from your window?

questions.text: Is your home quiet or noisy?
questions.say: Is your home quiet or noisy?
Now let's move on to talk about dancing. Do you like dancing?

questions.text: Did you learn to dance when you were a child?
questions.say: Did you learn to dance when you were a child?

questions.text: Is dancing popular in your country?
questions.say: Is dancing popular in your country?
Now let's move on to talk about sunny days. Do you like sunny days?

questions.text: What do you like to do when the weather is sunny?
questions.say: What do you like to do when the weather is sunny?

questions.text: Are there many sunny days where you live?
questions.say: Are there many sunny days where you live?

cueCard.topic: Describe a person who does an important job in your community.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you think their job is important.

questions.text: Describe a person who does an important job in your community.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a person who does an important job in your community. You should say: who this person is; what their job is; what they do every day; and explain why you think their job is important.

questions.text: Would you like to do this kind of job yourself?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you like to do this kind of job yourself?

questions.text: Which jobs do you think are the most important in society?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a person who does an important job in your community, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all important jobs. Which jobs do you think are the most important in society?

questions.text: Why are some important jobs, such as nursing, not very well paid?
questions.say: Why are some important jobs, such as nursing, not very well paid?

questions.text: Should people who do dangerous jobs be paid more?
questions.say: Should people who do dangerous jobs be paid more?

questions.text: What makes people happy in their jobs?
questions.say: Now let's talk about job satisfaction. What makes people happy in their jobs?

questions.text: Is a high salary more important than enjoying your work?
questions.say: Is a high salary more important than enjoying your work?

questions.text: Why do some people change their careers several times?
questions.say: Why do some people change their careers several times?
